keywords: Appeal from a partition judgement concerning a parcel of land; the Petitioner claimed sole prescriptive title against co-owners, alleging non-compliance with Section 4 of the Partition Act and challenging the trial judge\'s rejection of his documentary evidence. Held - co-owner\'s possession cannot become adverse possession merely by long occupation without clear evidence of ouster; upheld the District Judge\'s factual findings; Application dismissed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
